name: Sister-in-law Affair
source:
In this captivating adult visual novel, Sister-in-law Affair, main character, Jessica(his wife) and Laura(his sister-in-law) find themselves in an unexpected love triangle. As their lives intertwine, desires and passions ignite, leading to secret encounters and intense connections. Jessica's initial suspicion evolves into curiosity and acceptance, as she silently supports Main character and Laura's growing bond. Along their journey, they explore the complexities of desire, trust, and unconventional love, embracing their unique dynamic and discovering fulfillment in their shared experiences.

[From [url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/sisterly-affair]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在引人入胜的成人视觉小说《Sister-in-law Affair》中，男主人公、妻子杰西卡与妻子的姐妹劳拉，意外陷入一段三角关系。随着三人的生活交织，欲望与激情逐渐升温，秘密幽会与深切羁绊接踵而至。杰西卡最初的怀疑逐渐转变为好奇与接纳，默默支持着丈夫与劳拉日益加深的感情。在这段历程中，他们探索欲望、信任与非传统爱情的复杂之处，接受三人独特的相处方式，并在共同的经历中获得满足。

[摘自[url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/sisterly-affair]itch.io[/url]]
